items: The app is now called Prior, with a new logo.
Your theme and text size carry over. If you installed it on your iPhone Home Screen, delete the old icon and add it again to get the new name and icon.
Overview shows today's P&L, the last 12 runs and what changed since your last visit.
Your own Kalshi trades are labelled "You" and kept out of the bot's results.
Alert history and alert settings (daily summary, every fill or only problems, quiet hours).
Notifications on your iPhone Home Screen app (Chrome, Add to Home Screen).
Settings show what changed and offer Undo Last Change.
